name: figma-tools
description: Design-to-spec extraction for Claude Code, from two design sources: a Figma page or component set, and a designer-authored code prototype. Turns a Figma page into a gap spec in a repo that consumes a design system, a Figma component set into a component spec in the repo that is one, and a prototype preview URL into a per-ticket design brief — each resolved against a per-project design-system catalog that its ds-catalog skill generates and annotates, backed by the figma-region-extractor and figma-variant-extractor subagents. In a library repo it also turns a design brief into a proposed component the user steers in a UI component lab, which its create-ui-component-lab skill installs
